[[File:GeonosianWarRoom-AotC.jpg|thumb|250px|Geonosian War Room.]]
The '''Geonosian War Room''' was a command post situated inside one of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]' rocky [[Geonosian spire|spires]]. The room featured [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projectors, such as [[ARENA-7580]], and various communications stations, manned by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the War Room was used to stage large-scale training and exhibition battles, but during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] invasion the room functioned as the primary [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] command center.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> It was used by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Geonosian [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], and several [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] ambassadors.
